_meta._comment: Generated incident/NIS2 reports (reporting.py's _template_backend / nis2_template.py's build_report and build_incident_report -- both write into this same reports-* index; contracts/reporting.md's frozen alert-scoped schema plus the Phase 5 incident-report seam it documents as additive). ism-reports-365d.json attaches by index pattern, not by a template setting. Review-fix (2026-09-04, mapping_version 2): stage/language/entity/incident (build_report) and incident_id/evidence_verified/evidence_package_id (build_incident_report) were being written but were absent here -- with dynamic:false they were stored in _source but never indexed, silently unqueryable/unaggregatable. Added below; report_id's own format already disambiguates the two document kinds ({alert_id}:report vs {incident_id}:incident-report, see contracts/reporting.md).
